mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, slug, title, excerpt, cover_url, cover_asset_id, kind, status, version, like_count, comment_count, favorite_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM creator_post WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY published_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, owner_id, slug, title, excerpt, cover_url, cover_asset_id, kind, status, version, like_count, comment_count, favorite_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM creator_post WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY published_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creator_post WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT id, owner_id, slug, title, excerpt, body, cover_url, cover_asset_id, kind, status, version, like_count, comment_count, favorite_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM creator_post WHERE slug = #{slug} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE creator_post SET slug = #{slug}, title = #{title}, excerpt = #{excerpt}, body = #{body}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, cover_asset_id = #{coverAssetId}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED') AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE creator_post SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE creator_post SET status = 'ARCHIVED', version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED') AND version = #{expectedVersion}
